_doc: Grudges and gratitude (RIV-001, Karma system). acts: hostile acts the player can commit against an NPC. Per act: name, days (time taken), fight (the NPC must be beaten first), requires_stronger (your realm must be above theirs), alignment (shift when done), grudge (added to the victim's grudge), kin_grudge (added for each living parent, child and spouse of the victim), failed_grudge (victim's grudge if you attack and lose), favor (victim's favor change), kills (the victim dies), loot_stones [min, max] spirit stones per (victim realm index + 1) plus everything they carry. max_grudge / max_gratitude cap the ledgers. decay_per_year: grudges fade by this much each year (gratitude does not). amends: stones_per_point (spirit stones per grudge point to make amends), min_cost. Grudges are never held against the player by their own family, and children (younger than family.json adult_age) cannot be targeted.
